note: Paper: RMSProp (decay 0.9, momentum 0.9), BN momentum 0.99, weight decay 1e-5, initial LR 0.256 decaying 0.97 every 2.4 epochs, SiLU, AutoAugment, stochastic depth survival 0.8, dropout 0.2 (B0) to 0.5 (B7). The batch size and 350-epoch budget follow the authors' public TPU recipe (batch 4096) and are assumptions; label smoothing 0.1 is from that recipe. AutoAugment and EMA are not implemented here. Set model.name to b1..b7 and data.image_size to the matching resolution.
